# Packet relay

`cinnabar:extension/packet-relay@0.1.0`

Every session packet, relayed through one trusted mod. A batch is the session contract's batch
body: each packet as a varuint32 byte length followed by the encoded packet, header included,
in the session's protocol.

**Grants:** `packets` to run packet-mod callbacks; `wasi` separately enables the restricted WASI runtime.

<a id="type-session-pack"></a>

### `session-pack`

A resource pack the mod adds to the session.

```wit
record session-pack {
    archive: list<u8>,
    above-server: bool,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `archive` | `list<u8>` | The pack's zip archive; its manifest identity must not repeat another pack in the stack. |
| `above-server` | `bool` | Whether the pack applies above the server's packs rather than below them. |

<a id="type-outbound"></a>

### `outbound`
